items.title: Blake Wesley's deal with the LA Clippers is the second earliest 10 Day hardship signing. The earliest is Charles Bassey last year with the Memphis Grizzlies (Oct 27).
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Blake Wesley's deal with the LA Clippers is the second earliest 10 Day hardship signing. The earliest is Charles Bassey last year with the Memphis Grizzlies (Oct 27).

Back in 2021, the NBA changed rules to allow for 10 Day hardship signings before the normal 10 Day contract allowance on January 5.

items.author: Law Murray 📘
items.body_excerpt:
The LA Clippers will add Blake Wesley to the roster via a hardship exception ten-day contract.

Last night, the Clippers were down six standard contracts (Brandon Ingram, Max Strus, Rui Hachimura, Bradley Beal, Yanic Konan Niederhäuser, Jordan Miller). Clippers lead NBA in turnovers.
